messages:
Alex (Product): Quick sync — proposing a prioritization rubric for the Optimize toolkit pilot. TL;DR: customer signal importance -> rollout risk -> econ impact -> engineering cost. want to lock before next planning doc.
Mira (ML Eng): +1. Can we make the rubric actionable? e.g., signal: high-latency tail, actionable: batching+cache, estimated latency reduction: 40-60%.
Sophie (CS): From customers: top asks are 'lower 95th p latency' and 'predictable per-token cost'. both map nicely.
Priya (Eng): Agree. Suggest two buckets: MVP (low friction changes + safe defaults) and Stretch (quantization recs + model-specific tuning).
Joel (SRE): Operational constraints: must include fallback policy when batch queue grows > 200ms and an observable SLO for queueing.
Alex (Product): Proposal draft for MVP gating criteria — short list:
- Signal coverage: at least 3 pilot customers exhibiting relevant signals
- Measurable win: >15% cost or >20% P95 latency improvement for pilot
- Ops safe: rollback path + canary route
- Docs + runbook created
Mira (ML Eng): For signals, recommend capturing: request size distribution, seq length, prefix-hit rate for cache, and cold-start KV miss rate.
Priya (Eng): Here's a minimal canary config snippet we can use in demo:
```
route: optimize-mvp-canary
percent: 10
fallback: host-default
monitor: p95_latency, token_rate, batch_queue_ms
```
Sophie (CS): I'll surface this to Pilot customers — can we add an easy opt-in check they can run? like `curl /optimize-health` returns recommended mode.
Alex (Product): Good call. Add acceptance test: customer-run healthcheck + perf snapshot pre/post.
deploy-bot: branch "optimize-rubric-v1" deployed to staging :rocket:
Joel (SRE): Alerting: create eval-trigger rule when model-output-drift > 5% on core prompts OR when cache-hit drops > 10% for 2 mins. Notify #eng-oncall + product.
Mira (ML Eng): For quantization recs (stretch) — include a safety net: automatic A/B validation set to auto-reject if lexical/semantic drift > configured threshold.
Alex (Product): Ok next steps:
1) finalize rubric doc (I'll update and share link)
2) Priya + Mira to draft MVP impl plan and canary config
3) Sophie to line up 3 pilot customers willing to run healthcheck
4) Joel to draft alerting & rollback runbook
Meeting check: can we aim to gate acceptance by EOD next Wed? :calendar:
Priya (Eng): EOD Wed works for engineering draft.
Sophie (CS): I'll ping two customers today, third by Monday.
Mira (ML Eng): I'll prepare the validation metric definitions and one-liner tooling to compute them.
Alex (Product): sweet — thanks all. I'll post the rubric doc and assign owners. :thumbsup:
